calibration.reason: Benchmark v1 required all annotated supporting documents for every multi-relevance query to appear in the top five. The first representative dual-GPU measurement showed every query had a relevant rank-1 result while one secondary supporting document fell outside top-5. V2 preserves a high full-set Recall@5 floor, adds an explicit all-query Hit@5 requirement, and requires a material Recall@5 gain over the deterministic lexical baseline.
calibration.policy: primary-relevance coverage plus secondary-support quality; no query may miss all relevant documents in top-5

documents.text: A camera can be reachable at Layer 2 yet unavailable from the monitoring server when the switch access VLAN is wrong. Verify access VLAN, trunk allowed VLANs, native VLAN, gateway, and the server routing path before changing camera settings.

Intermittent connectivity after a device replacement can be caused by a duplicate IPv4 address or stale DHCP lease. Compare ARP MAC changes, DHCP lease ownership, switch port MAC learning, and probe results before assigning a new address.

If an IP address works but a hostname fails, preserve DNS query evidence and compare resolver configuration, search domains, response codes, and reachability to configured DNS servers. Do not treat this as an application failure until DNS is excluded.

Packet loss diagnosis should separate local interface errors, switch port counters, duplex or speed mismatch, congestion, WAN loss, and remote endpoint loss. Correlate timestamps rather than relying on a single ping sample.

For a PoE camera that disappears completely, inspect PoE switch power state, per-port power draw, link state, LLDP or MAC-table history, and upstream power events. No ARP, ONVIF, HTTP, or RTSP response together can indicate power or physical-layer loss rather than bad credentials.

RTSP timeout with successful ICMP and HTTP management access points toward stream configuration, port filtering, codec load, session limits, or RTSP service state. Capture TCP connect result and RTSP status before rebooting the camera.

ONVIF discovery failure does not prove a camera is offline. Check WS-Discovery multicast reachability, ONVIF enablement, service port, VLAN multicast policy, and then test the known device IP directly.

HTTP or RTSP 401 responses prove the service answered but authentication failed. Preserve status code and device identity, verify credential scope and clock-related authentication issues, and avoid classifying the device as unreachable.

A simultaneous loss of camera link, switch management, and site telemetry is stronger evidence of upstream power loss than a camera-only alarm. Correlate UPS, smart PDU, PoE switch, gateway, and last-seen timestamps to distinguish power failure from network isolation.

When monitoring fails only from one subnet, compare route tables, firewall policy, ACL counters, NAT, and reverse-path reachability. A successful local probe from the device VLAN does not prove the monitoring collector has a valid route.

Repeated failed logins followed by a success from a new source require evidence preservation: authentication logs, source IP, user identity, device time, MFA result, session creation, and subsequent privileged actions. Do not delete logs while investigating.

A burst of connection attempts across many ports may be scanning, but classification should use source identity, destination spread, timing, allowlisted scanners, IDS evidence, and asset ownership. Discovery traffic alone is not proof of compromise.

queries.text: Camera mất hoàn toàn, không ping, không ONVIF, không RTSP; làm sao phân biệt mất nguồn PoE với lỗi cấu hình?
Ping camera được và mở web được nhưng RTSP timeout, nên kiểm tra đâu trước?
Không discover được ONVIF nhưng biết IP camera và camera vẫn có thể online
Camera trả HTTP 401 thì có phải mất kết nối mạng không?
Camera cắm đúng switch nhưng server monitoring ở VLAN khác không truy cập được
Thiết bị chập chờn sau khi thay camera, nghi trùng IP hoặc DHCP lease cũ
Truy cập bằng IP được nhưng dùng hostname thì lỗi
Packet loss lúc có lúc không, cần tách lỗi switch, duplex, congestion hay WAN
Nhiều camera và cả switch cùng mất telemetry một lúc, có phải mất điện site không?
Chỉ collector ở subnet khác không giám sát được thiết bị, local probe vẫn thành công
Nhiều login fail rồi có một login success từ IP mới, cần giữ bằng chứng gì?
Một máy thử kết nối rất nhiều port, làm sao phân biệt scanner hợp lệ với dấu hiệu xâm nhập?
